ways.climb: Press E to climb the ladder
ways.run: Hold Shift to run, double-tap to keep running

pill.take: Press E to take the pill
pill.ask: Press {yes} to swallow, {no} to put down

door.open: Press E to open the door

controls.walk: Drag here to walk, further to run
controls.use: Tap to use what is in reach

offer.hint: Press E to see the offer
offer.hintYours: Press E to see your room
offer.title: A room on floor {floor}
offer.size: {side} m a side, {height} m to the ceiling
offer.short: Not enough cubes. Type cube.giveCubes() in the browser’s console for more.
offer.nobody: Buying takes cubes. Type cube.giveCubes() in the browser’s console to get some.
offer.demo: A demo: cubes are free for now, and they and your rooms live only in this browser.

account.or: Or log in with the words you were given:
account.pasted: Your twelve words, or your login link
account.wrongWords: These are not the twelve words of any account: check for a typo.
account.wrongId: These words belong to another id.
account.secret: Anyone with these twelve words owns your rooms, and nobody can give them back if you lose them. Keep them one of these ways:
account.unstorable: This browser keeps nothing: your account lasts until the page closes.
account.saved: Your browser should now offer to save it.
account.link: A link that logs another device in
account.linkWarning: Whoever opens it owns your rooms, so send it only to yourself.
